name: NFL Scout vibe filters
purpose: Keep club-room NFL news. Quiet is better than junk.

pull.note: Pull ~10 search_news hits, then filter, then keep 3. Do not backfill a slot with a leftover that failed.

keep: Injury, PUP, IR, designation, surgery, or practice status for this club or a player on this club
Signing, cut, trade, extension, tryout, or roster battle on this club
Joint practice, preseason, or camp involving this club as a participant
Ownership, stadium, or staff move for this club
A current player or coach of this club in this week's news (rankings, quotes, snaps)
drop: Other pro sports (MLB, NBA, NHL, MLS, F1, golf, tennis, boxing) even if the city matches
College football (uniforms, portal, NCAA, campus rivalry) unless the person is on this club's current roster this week
Wrong club: this team is not a participant. Do not park leftover league stories here
Celebrity, streamer, flag football, or crossover stunt
Trading cards, merch, creator lists, podcast endings, fan uniform edits
Body/looks, locker-room gag, hot-dog fridge, mental-health PR clapback
Nostalgia recap of a game or career more than ~2 years old with no new news
Near-duplicate of another item already kept for this club
